snippet.title: MR. RECORDS | Announcement Trailer | Day of The Devs SGF
snippet.description:
MR. RECORDS is an uplifting single-player rhythm adventure featuring vinyl store management by day and surreal musical journeys by night. Join George and his loyal dog Buzz as they uncover memories, emotions, and stories hidden within every record.
